Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Aditi - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Karan - 40 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Meera - 10 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Aditi, Sunita and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "Sunita, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal folds his hands and prays.]

Aditi (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal lights a diya.]

Sunita: "Okay, Kunal."

[Aditi draws a rangoli at the door.]

Sunita: "Karan, look at this."

[Kunal paints a picture.]

Kunal: "I'm ready!"

[Kunal draws a picture of the house.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sunita and Karan stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal irons his school shirt.]

Kunal: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Sunita: "Karan, are you okay?"

[Kunal's phone rings and he answers it.]

Kunal: "Dad, listen!"

[Kunal lies down on the sofa.]

Sunita (gently): "Karan, are you okay?"

[Kunal flops down on the sofa.]

Karan: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal slams the door shut.]

Kunal (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
